name: MicroVQA
intro: MicroVQA 是面向生物显微研究的多模态推理基准。12 名专家创建 1,061 条原始问答，经 NBME 式提示优化、RefineBot 去除语言捷径及原创建者全量复核后发布 1,042 道测试题；论文和数据卡均未披露 19 条样本的流失规则。官方评测采用多模态思维链提示和精确数字解析，解析失败仍留在全量分母中并记错。
org: Stanford University; Tsinghua University; University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill; Princeton University; KTH Royal Institute of Technology; Chan Zuckerberg Biohub Network
build_method: 专家构建, 两阶段MCQ生成, 多智能体优化
metric: Accuracy（全量分母；解析失败记错）
task_type: 视觉问答, 科学问答
eval_feature: 研究级推理, 显微图像, 语言捷径控制
scale: 1,042道测试题（由1,061条原始样本构建；19条流失规则未披露）
build_method_en: Expert Curation, Two-stage MCQ Generation, Multi-agent Refinement
eval_feature_en: Research-level Reasoning, Microscopy Images, Language-shortcut Control
intro_en: MicroVQA is a multimodal reasoning benchmark for biological microscopy. Twelve experts created 1,061 raw VQA samples; NBME-style prompt optimization, RefineBot shortcut removal, and full original-creator review produced a 1,042-question test release, while neither the paper nor dataset card reports the 19-item attrition rule. Official evaluation uses a multimodal chain-of-thought prompt and exact numeric parsing, with parse failures retained in the full denominator as incorrect.
scale_en: 1,042 test MCQs from 1,061 raw samples; the 19-item attrition rule is not reported
metric_en: Accuracy (full denominator; parse failures are incorrect)

drawio_review_note: Primary-source review against arXiv:2503.13399v1, especially Sections 3.2, 4.1-4.2, 5.1 and Appendices C, D.1-D.9, E.1-E.6, F.1 and F.5; the official code repository is pinned at https://github.com/jmhb0/microvqa/tree/3b52dc7131c3a285c33654856b349d9073e3604b and the released Hugging Face dataset card at https://huggingface.co/datasets/jmhb/microvqa/tree/744d656b41f2d9f9bf8f229283271bd67ee782fd. The bilingual source diagrams preserve the nine-PI/postdoc task consultation; twelve expert contributors; redistributable own, database and CC-BY image sources; at most six RGB images or video frames; 1,061 raw samples; and the paper's approximately 600 expert-hours. The fixed project homepage says eleven experts, but the paper, its tables, and released data support twelve, so the page retains twelve and records the website as stale or conflicting. The construction README also says private raw responses contain PII and cannot be released, so the construction stage is not fully reproducible from public artifacts. The source discrepancy in quality-control timing remains explicit: Section 4.1 says feedback after the first 10 and 40 submissions, whereas Appendix E.1 describes an initial four-to-six-question manual check. Stage one records the physician-scientist's 50 NBME-aligned gold MCQs and DSPy MIPROv2 optimization with o1-mini CoT/RAG and a separately judged weighted metric. Stage two records RefineBot's no-image evaluator, accumulated reflection, rewrite, equivalence check and five-iteration cap. A successful candidate must then be answered incorrectly on two random seeds spanning GPT-4o-2024-08-06 and Claude-3.5-Sonnet-20241022; failed runs are retried with new seeds, and questions that never pass retain their Stage-one MCQ. Every released question is reviewed by its original creator. The paper reports 1,061 raw and 1,042 final questions but does not disclose the nineteen-item attrition rule. The pinned dataset has one test split with 1,042 rows, including 423 multi-image questions, under CC BY-SA 4.0. The pinned evaluator formats one-indexed choices, requests 'The answer is (X)', takes the first case-sensitive regex match allowing optional bold/parentheses, subtracts one, maps no match to -1, and computes overall and per-task means over all rows so malformed outputs count incorrect. The paper describes special LLaVA/LLaVA-Med prefix/suffix handling, but the pinned eval code applies one shared prompt; its CLI loads the test split while a batch helper still requests a nonexistent train split. The code repository has no top-level license at the pinned commit. The official project page explicitly names a Leaderboard and embeds docs/static/leaderboard/leaderboard.html, although no formal public submission workflow is documented; therefore has_leaderboard is true while openness remains partly public. Formal publication evidence [site-a11u-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 2005×825 (English) and 2005×825 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 2003×823 and 2003×823. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
